text: I felt anxious and alone tonight.
The day left me upset and discouraged.
I am frustrated that nothing worked out.
I had trouble getting through the day.
I completed my normal morning routine.
I prepared dinner and cleaned the kitchen.
I attended class and came home afterward.
Today was similar to most other days.
I am thankful for the people around me.
I had fun and laughed a lot today.
I feel confident about what comes next.
